script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for January 19. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.

Right now, energy is flowing through you—chemical energy from food, electrical energy in your nerves, thermal energy keeping you warm.  And here's the mind-bending part: that energy will never disappear.  It will only change form.

The energy in your morning eggs came from chicken feed, which came from plants, which captured sunlight. You are, quite literally, running on stored sunshine. Energy flows through food chains, changing form but never vanishing. A single lightning bolt releases about 1 billion joules of energy—enough to toast 100,000 slices of bread.  In an instant, electrical potential energy transforms into light, heat, and sound.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Energy conservation applies to more than physics.  Your effort, your love, your work—they don't disappear.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Energy Awareness - Notice the Flow.

Here's your activity: Today, trace energy through your day: the electricity powering your devices came from somewhere, your food's energy came from somewhere. Pick one object and trace its energy back three steps. Everything is connected. This helps you recognize energy transformations in daily life.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about how energy changes form can be applied to energy awareness - notice the flow. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
